edits.before: Q-poke the contacts — the stack passive means your carry's autos are CC in progress.
edits.after: Soraka pays health for every Starcall cast and has no escape — walk her down, stun follows.

edits.before: Concussive trades begin: three hits and the stun votes; trade in stack windows.
edits.after: Q into Concussive Blows all-ins a healer with zero escape — she can't kite your stun.

edits.before: Full kit: E eats their poke and W teleports the peel — the lane plays through your shield.
edits.after: You punish her self-damage poke pattern — every Starcall she casts pays HP she can't get back.

edits.before: First item: the wall hardens and the stack windows chain into kills.
edits.after: First item you out-trade her — all-ins chunk faster than she heals it.

edits.before: Late Braum is the wall: E their teamfight's biggest cast, R their engage, stun whoever touches the carry.
edits.after: Late Soraka out-scales you: global Wish and layered healing keep her ADC topped through your all-ins.

edits.before: - Soraka Equinox: matchup-defining — The silence zone cancels your engage mid-cast — step out before the root snaps. It writes your spacing rules. - E Unbreakable is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Soraka's Equinox (E) is 20/19/18/17/16s CD — the silence zone cancels your engage mid-cast, step out before the root snaps. - Wish (R) is 150/135/120s CD — force it early with your engage. - Your own Unbreakable (E) runs 16/14/12/10/8s CD.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: She pays HP for every Starcall and Infuse — an all-in war of attrition favors you before she has heals that matter.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Equinox is only 20s CD at rank 1 — walling after it's spent still burns your engage for nothing.
